newsitem.title: CHINA: HK 1997 legislature includes 33 current lawmakers.
newsitem.headline: HK 1997 legislature includes 33 current lawmakers.

text.p: The speaker of Hong Kong's Legislative Council and 32 other incumbent lawmakers were among the 60 members of a provisional legislature founded by China on Saturday, to be installed in the territory next July.

Legco speaker Andrew Wong, who is an independent legislator, and pro-Beijing Liberal Party leader Allen Lee were among the incumbents elected by a 400-strong China-controlled Selection Committee in the frontier city of Shenzhen.
Dominic Chan, who was recently expelled from the Democratic Party, Hong Kong's largest, was also among the 60 elected. The Democratic Party has boycotted the selection as anti-democratic.

The winners also included pro-China politicians, such as Tsang Yok-sing, Elsie Tu and Peggy Lam, who were roundly beaten in 1995 Legco elections when more than a million people went to the polls and voted overwhelmingly for pro-democracy forces.
